fusions.name: Chariot Charge
fusions.desc: Drives a gallop through a cone 5 tiles long ahead of you that deals 30 damage, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, to everything in it. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Passing Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks the target in passing for 8 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Carries you 7 tiles forward at a gallop. Your movement speed rises 30% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Pace
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
